diagnosis.answer_markdown:
The projected MemoryPressure condition is False for example-node.

Earlier pressure may have cleared, but current usage remains unknown because the Metrics API was unavailable. Confidence: low. To verify: A later bounded Node metrics read and fresh condition agree in the same window.

The current Node metrics observation was unavailable. Impact: CPU and memory totals cannot be confirmed and the condition alone does not establish capacity.

Suggested next step: Retry the bounded Node metrics read after availability is restored. Risk: Cordon or drain would mutate scheduling and is not part of this read-only workflow. Before acting: Do not infer a causal workload or change the Node.
